lodes.why: The owner, 2026-11-12: Xanadu's lore has plentiful gold mines paying for the gold on everything (LORE.md 6.13), but the geology gave only low-grade gold; a rich field near Qiblai and Strongwall, the best spot near a pin (openworld/TRADE-GOODS.md).

The owner, 2026-11-16: Thalaba's own small sulfur deposit, 30 t a year, at the cataract's foot (Gāḍz-Phōl) where Godshearth's spillway cut the shield's old fumarole lines; worked by Salphar, the diggers' hamlet (settlements/thalaba/PLAN.md section 4). Stamped 2026-11-16 with the mined goods' bake (the owner: "Bake now").

Lightwall PLAN.md 1 and 4 (the owner, 2026-11-16): the Great Potch Line, the richest opal in Opal Valley. A field of short veins of Rift Black Opal along the north boundary fault's foot, where it cuts the basalt dikes behind Lāiṭwāl. Each vein lasts 2-3 years, the field over 200. Sent by the Lightwall session (settlements/lightwall/PLAN.md section 6, step L0).
